utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—what’s the latest list of needed items?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still catching up, but I can help sort the list if you have it. What items are already confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together too—so far I’ve heard tools and spare parts are needed, but I don’t have the full list yet.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I can help spread the word and keep a list of supplies people can bring. Send me the details, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Mara — please start with the supplies list, and I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what and where it needs to go.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll start the supplies list and send it your way. Thanks, Opal, that’ll make this much easier.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah — just bring a screwdriver, a wrench, and a tape measure, and we’ll be set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll grab a screwdriver, a wrench, and a tape measure. Thanks for the reminder, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Noah — just bring those by when you’re ready, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right — I’ll bring the screwdriver set and sturdy tape. Just tell me where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll let everyone know where to drop things off and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’ll drop them off wherever you point me. Just remind me if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Kira — I’ll keep track of the supplies for the repair drive. Just let me know what’s still needed, and I’ll check what we have.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm what supplies are already covered and what you still need me to decide?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can do that — I’ll check our current supplies and tell you what’s covered and what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep it simple until the details are ready. Send me anything you want included, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep checking for the repair details while I’m out and send anything useful your way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep it simple and let folks know the details are still coming. Send anything useful when you have it, and I’ll spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Start with the leaking faucet and the loose porch step.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that helps—I’ll want to know when it starts so I can plan the ride over. If there’s a list of materials, please send that too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send the materials list, and I’ll let you know when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help keep people linked up — if you hear what tools or parts are still needed, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I don’t have the tools or parts list yet. Let’s first confirm the date, location, and what needs fixing, then I can pass along the rest.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds good — once we’ve got the date, location, and list of repairs, I can help get the word out to the right folks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got the faucet and porch step at the top of the list, and I’ll keep everyone posted as we go.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I can help with the faucet and porch step, and I’ll check in on the other houses that need help most.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey — that’s really helpful. I’ll keep the faucet and porch step at the top of the list and let you know the next houses as I hear about them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard a final yes yet, but I’ll check around and let you know the time and what to bring if it’s on.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — that works for me. Just let me know when you hear back, and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and pass along whatever I hear, including the time and any list of things to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have they said what kinds of repairs the drive is covering yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, but I’m making a quick list so I’m ready once they do. I’d rather be organized than guess at it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — if you find out, let me know. I’m mainly wondering whether it covers just basics or bigger fixes too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m still on for Saturday at 10, and I’ll bring the screwdriver set if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks — that’s covered, and I can still handle the shed check. If you want, I can also help with either the yard cleanup or the shelf repair first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — let’s do the yard cleanup first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep it simple until the details are ready. Send me anything you want shared, and I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm who’s actually bringing what, and whether Saturday at 10 is still locked in?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can check on that and send a quick update once it’s confirmed — Saturday at 10 still sounds like the plan for now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, but I’m going to ask when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — thanks, Ira. I’ll keep spreading the word so folks know what still needs to be brought.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know if I hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll do that—once I’ve got the list, I’ll send it over. Thanks again, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli — once you send it over, I can sort the donated tools and check which houses need help most.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Rey. I’ll get the list together and send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I still only have the basics, so let’s pin down the date, location, and what needs fixing first. What do we know so far about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We know the repair drive starts at the school lot, and the first fixes are the broken fence gate by the lot and the loose step by the entrance. I can help work the timing around school drop-off and pickup once the slots are set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, that gives us a start — school lot, broken fence gate, and loose step by the entrance. Let’s pin down the date and time slots next, especially around drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great — what’s the latest list of needed items?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m good for Saturday at 10, and I can bring a screwdriver set if I find it. What else do you need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s perfect — the screwdriver set helps a lot. I’ll ask around for any other tools or spare parts we still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll keep connecting folks and pass along any needs I hear about, and you can keep the list tidy for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — send me anything you hear, and I’ll keep the list organized. If we can pin down the date, place, and what needs fixing, we’ll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out for the date, place, and any urgent fixes, and send them your way as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it was a screwdriver, a wrench, and a tape measure, plus any spare screws and gloves if I can find them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks — I’d still want to confirm the time before I plan around it. If it’s really on, I can figure out the ride and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I should double-check the time too — I’m a little scattered today. I’ll bring the tools and see if I can round up the spare screws and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep the list organized and point folks to the right place for each repair.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—please keep the faucet and porch step first. I’ll point people to the parts and tools as they show up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep faucet and porch step at the top of the list and track where to send each helper.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I’m still keeping it simple, but I’ll send the repair drive details soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — send the details when you’re ready, and I’ll jump in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate that. I’ll send them over as soon as I’ve got everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll poke around and see if it’s still happening this weekend, and I’ll let you know the time and what to bring if I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess — please let me know if it’s still on and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll check around and get back to you as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’ve got the screwdriver set and sturdy tape ready. Just tell me where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — bring them by my place, and I’ll mark them down. I’ll let you know if we still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great — I’ll swing by your place with them. Just let me know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — send me your list when you’ve got it, and I’ll see what tools I can lend for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ll send you the list once I’ve got it together, and I really appreciate the tool help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — just send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll see what I’ve got for the repair drive.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
